name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Payroll Assistance
benefit: **Financial Assistance** **Activity****Payroll Assistance**Garment, Apparel&amp;amp; Made-ups (including Composite Unit) ₹5,000/- per Female Worker &amp;amp; ₹4,000/- per Male Worker per monthTechnical Textile (including Composite Unit) ₹3,000/- per Female Worker &amp;amp; ₹2,000 per Male Worker per month
_eligibility_text:
1. The scheme is applicable to industrial units in the Garment, Apparel & Made-ups, and Technical Textile sectors (including Composite Units).
1. The workers must be domiciled in Gujarat and registered under the EPF scheme.
1. The unit must apply within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
